caption: The drawing features a single, large, black abstract shape centered on a plain off-white background. The shape consists of thick, curving and straight lines intersecting at various angles. At the top of the composition, there is a broad, U-shaped curve with outward-facing ends. Attached to the midpoint of this upper curve, a thick straight line descends diagonally to the lower right. A shorter, straight horizontal line extends from the middle left of this descending line. Near the bottom, another curve, this time opening downward, mirrors the top curve and is attached to the lower end of the descending line. The overall form is solid black without shading or gradients, and the background is unmarked except for slight discoloration near the top edge.
title: Cattle Brand
